visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of chopsticks places a yellow savory zongzi onto a hot, black circular griddle. A man with shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a pink t-shirt, appears in a bottom-right inset, gesturing with two smaller zongzi in his hands while looking at the camera. (2) The griddle lid is pressed down, flattening the zongzi into a thin, pancake-like shape. The camera captures steam rising and the rice becoming crispy and brown. The man's facial expression in the inset shows high excitement and anticipation. (3) The scene shifts to a larger indoor kitchen setting where the man is now the main focus, holding a white plate with the flattened savory zongzi. He uses chopsticks to take a large bite, his eyes widening as he chews enthusiastically. (4) A second, translucent yellow sweet alkaline zongzi is placed into a silver rectangular sandwich press. The lid is pressed down firmly with a hand, causing the sticky rice to spread out and become thin and almost transparent in some areas. (5) Close-up shots highlight the glistening texture of the flattened sweet zongzi, showing dark red bean filling inside. The man continues to provide energetic commentary, pointing at the food and smiling at the camera, conveying extreme satisfaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat pop background music with a steady synthesized beat and melodic synth lines begins immediately. A male voice starts speaking at a fast rate with a high pitch and bright, friendly tone, introducing the food concept. (2) A sharp, prolonged sizzling sound starts as the zongzi hits the hot plate, marking the start of a new phase. The music continues at a constant volume while the vocal track maintains high arousal and positive valence. (3) The vocal delivery becomes more exaggerated as the speaker says 'Wow!', followed by a quick 'pop' sound effect used for a transition. The ambient noise floor is low, resembling a clean indoor studio environment. (4) A mechanical 'clack' sound occurs when the sandwich press is closed. The speaker's intensity increases, shouting in a high-arousal voice with a rising intonation pattern. The music remains dominant, with a clear rhythm and electronic drum hits. (5) The final phase features a 'ding' sound effect as celebratory text overlays appear visually. The voice transitions to a slightly calmer but still very enthusiastic summary, while the music sustains its energy until the end.
